summary: User-model event bus. Exports a singleton object whose handlers map is a Store named "eventHandlers" (module 1176). on(type, handler) appends a handler to the list for that type; emit(event) calls every handler registered for event.type and then clears that list (one-shot semantics); remove(type, handler) splices a single handler out of the list. No DOM or Vue involvement.

exports.default: event bus singleton { handlers, on(type, handler), emit(event), remove(type, handler) }
